newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, forward sentiment improving.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, forward sentiment improving.

text.p: NWE spot naphtha prices held notionally steady in thin trade but improving sentiment saw January swaps holding firm, traders said.

Perceptions of fresh petrochemical demand for second half January saw Jan swaps holding firm at values around $224.50 a tonne cif NWE although Feb contracts remained backwardated by around $5 a tonne.
Traders said the spot market should still have an overhang of supply but scarce buyers saw no product being offered to support this perception.
They said recent strength in U.S. gasoline may have pulled some of the surplus heavier grades transatlantic but saw few outlets for lighter grades with demand for parrafinic and full range very thin.
Spot prices were notionally steady with full range material around $217/$220 and N+A some $6-7 below this.
